description: Liberia-Small Mini-Grid LV-NEA Project is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Project sites", published or maintained by NRECA International (NRECA International). This layer contains small mini-grid project LV line route and characteristics that is proposed under NEA project analysis. Coverage: Liberia. It has 2 files in SHP ZIP, GeoJSON. The portal files it under Project sites. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
